stability.preprocessing_and_scaling_scope: full caller source before resampling; internal source search only

stable_mcuve.tie_rule: caller full-source ordinary MC-UVE ranking, then its stable index order

stable_cars.tie_rule: caller full-source ordinary MC-UVE ranking, then its stable index order

stable_joint.tie_rule: caller full-source ordinary MC-UVE ranking, then its stable index order

stability.joint_resample_diagnostic_rule: per-resample indicator mean with same full-source MC tie rank; global fit uses global averaged frequencies

neural_training.input: caller-source fitted preprocessing and StandardScaler; no MC feature cut
neural_training.loss_semantics: PyTorch weighted CE normalized by weights present in each mini-batch; epoch report is batch-size weighted mean, not full-source global weighted CE
neural_training.prediction: softmax argmax equals logit argmax; returned scores are logits
